newsitem.title: UK: Bank unveils home mortgage plan for UK Muslims.
newsitem.headline: Bank unveils home mortgage plan for UK Muslims.

text.p: United Bank of Kuwait Plc's Islamic Investment Banking unit said on Monday it launched a home mortgage programme aimed at Britain's Muslim population.
The London-based unit said the plan, called Manzil, would provide a facility for practising Muslims to buy and own their own home in a way that was compatible with their religious beliefs.
Under strict Islamic law, Muslims are forbidden from either paying or receiving interest.

The bank's plan uses a method of finance common in Muslim countries, whereby clients' chosen property is bought by a bank and then immediately sold to its client at a fixed mark-up with payment deferred over a number of years and months.
Economically, the effect is comparable to a fixed-rate mortgage, but legally, the deal is a purchase and sale rather than a loan at interest.
